title: Helion Energy display heading
description: An all-caps display heading in a tight neo-grotesk (weight 500, line height 0.92, −1% tracking), fluid from 32px on phones to 55px at 1440, with line breaks on desktop only or everywhere and an optional stepped (indented) first line.
notes: takes the colour and alignment of its parent (or className)
name: helionenergy-heading

props.name: lines
props.description: the heading's lines; they break where the original breaks them

props.name: breakOn
props.description: "lg": break only on desktop (phones wrap freely); "always": break on every width

props.name: indentFirst
props.description: indent the first line (the hero's stepped opening)
